♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 BƆRA! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, AutoCaptions ni **Your script** ani **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** ye, ani **Flex Studio (Beta)** min bɛ jigin fɔlɔ, ka i ɲininka sani a ka sigi.

*(A sigi i ka verisiyɔn min bɛ i fɛ sisan, o kan, ka After Effects daminɛ kokura siɲɛ kelen.)*

♦️ **Kura: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* **Map desk** labɛncogo, yɔrɔw ɲinini k'a sɔrɔ ɛntɛrinɛti tɛ, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route ani fɛn wɛrɛw), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, karti cogo gansanw ani **Open in Flex Maps**.
* A ka baarakɛminɛn farankanw (ɲɔgɔndan sisan, cogow, tɔgɔw, 3D, Finalize) bɛ don After Effects kɔnɔ ka ɲɛ sisan.

♦️ **Fɛn kuraw AutoCaptions kɔnɔ**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (cloud, a bɛ Flex AI kredi baara) de ye motɛri laadilen ye, a sugandira siɲɛ kelen mɔgɔ bɛɛ ye. Whisper sugandi tugun walasa ka kumasɛbɛnw dilan gansan i ka ɔridinatɛri kan (Translate To mago bɛ Whisper la). Ni sɛriwɛri bɛ baara caman na, a bɛ i yɔrɔ jira makɔnɔnikɛlaw cɛ.
* **Your script**: kumasɛbɛnw bɛ i ka sɛbɛn sɛbɛncogo ni a kumaw ta, yɔrɔ o yɔrɔ i ye o kumaw fɔ.
* **Editable template** bɔli: kumasɛbɛnw bɛ kɛ template layer ye, i bɛ se ka u cogo yɛlɛma Essential Properties kɔnɔ (After Effects 2026).
* Foyi ma sugandi, Source media fana lankolon don? A bɛ **composition bɛɛ** di i ma. Kumakan kelen ka transcript kɔrɔ bɛ baara tugun.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** bɛ a jigin fɔlɔ, o kɔ a bɛ i ɲininka **Install / Not now**.
* Porogaramu (2.0.0-beta.2): baarakɛyɔrɔ **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, baarakɛminɛn butɔnw i n'a fɔ After Effects, klipuw bɛ dayɛlɛ joona, ani OPEN bɛ baara precomp ni adjustment layer kan fana sisan.

♦️ **Labɛnna**
* Tɛmu cogo (theme effects) minnu tun tɛ Windows PC caman kan, olu seginna (u bɛ nɔgɔya ni Windows ka animasiyɔn cogo datugura).

♦️ **Yɔrɔ jirali (n'i b'a fɛ) lisansi lakanani kama**
* A bɛ ɲininka siɲɛ kelen dɔrɔn, n'i b'a fɛ: hali n'i ye **No thanks** sugandi, fɛn bɛɛ bɛ baara ka ɲɛ. A yɛlɛma **Flex Settings > Privacy** kɔnɔ. A bɛ mara kalo 12, a tɛ feere abada, a tɛ di mɔgɔ wɛrɛ ma fo ni sariya y'a ɲini.

ult.message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 BƆRA! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack donna AutoCaptions kɔnɔ** ni kuma kelen kelen cogo, labɛncogo, lamaga ani mankanw ye. **UN-NEST** ni blend modes bɛ baara Premiere 26.5 kan, **AUTO CUT** ye digili kelen dɔrɔn ye, ani **Flex Studio (Beta)** bɛ i ka klipu dayɛlɛ ka bɔ panel kɔnɔ.

*(A sigi i ka verisiyɔn min bɛ i fɛ sisan, o kan, ka Premiere Pro daminɛ kokura siɲɛ kelen.)*

♦️ **Kura: kumasɛbɛn lamagalenw AutoCaptions kɔnɔ**
* **Kuma cogo**: kuma o kuma, a yɛrɛ ka kulɛriw, a ka sɛbɛnni sugu ani Flat, Shine walima Glow labanni di a ma.
* **Sira labɛncogo**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside ani Line.
* **Lamaga kuma kelen kelen na** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake ani fɛn wɛrɛw) ni ɲɛfɛlajɛ ye, ani **Pop / Tick / Swoosh** mankanw. Kuma cogow ni lamaga mago bɛ **Images** bɔli la.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (cloud, a bɛ Flex AI kredi baara) de ye motɛri laadilen ye sisan, a sugandira siɲɛ kelen mɔgɔ bɛɛ ye; Whisper motɛri dɔ sugandi walasa ka kumasɛbɛnw dilan gansan k'a sɔrɔ ɛntɛrinɛti tɛ.
* **Your script** (Captions cogo): kumasɛbɛnw bɛ i ka sɛbɛn kumaw ta yɔrɔ min i ye o kumaw fɔ.
* Foyi ma sugandi (Source karti lankolon don)? A bɛ **timeline bɛɛ** di i ma; kumasɛbɛnw bɛ mara i ka porozɛ kɛrɛfɛ.

♦️ **Kura: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** bɛ klipu nɔ tugu porogaramu kɔnɔ; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** bɛ o nɔ segin. A ma sigi fɔlɔ? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** bɛ a jigin, o kɔ a bɛ i ɲininka **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Yɛlɛmaliw**
* **AUTO CUT** bɛ klipu sugandilen sɛgɛsɛgɛ ka a tigɛ ni digili kelen ye. **Retakes** bɛ kumasen minnu daminɛna kokura, olu minɛ.
* **Audio Studio** ye sub-tab wɔɔrɔ ye sisan. **Library** bɛ Nest Saver kɔnɔ sisan.

♦️ **Labɛnna**
* **UN-NEST** Premiere 26.5 kan (a tun bɛ nest bɛɛ ban), ani blend modes i n'a fɔ Screen minnu tun bɛ segin Normal ma (Premiere angilɛkan na).
* **AUTOSAVE 0:00** taamasyɛn bilenman, Caption Stack ɲɛfɛlajɛ finman, ani tɛmu cogo minnu tun tɛ Windows PC caman kan.

♦️ **Yɔrɔ jirali (n'i b'a fɛ) lisansi lakanani kama**
* A bɛ ɲininka siɲɛ kelen dɔrɔn, n'i b'a fɛ: hali n'i ye **No thanks** sugandi, fɛn bɛɛ bɛ baara ka ɲɛ. A yɛlɛma **Flex Settings > Privacy** kɔnɔ. A bɛ mara kalo 12, a tɛ feere abada, a tɛ di mɔgɔ wɛrɛ ma fo ni sariya y'a ɲini.
